stops.name: Monte Paterno
stops.detail: From this period evident remains still exist (trenches, tunnels, barracks) on the massif and on the nearby Monte Paterno.

stops.name: Rifugio Auronzo
stops.detail: The Rifugio Auronzo, the starting point for the main excursions, is located at the end of the toll road that ascends from Misurina, and can be reached by car, for a limited number of spots, or by bus thanks to the Misura - Tre Cime shuttle managed by Dolomiti Bus.
